response.sql: WITH rep AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), s AS (SELECT EmployeeId, City, cnt, AVG(cnt * 1.0) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_avg, SUM(cnt) OVER () AS total FROM rep) SELECT City, SUM(cnt) AS total_customers, AVG(cnt - city_avg) AS avg_above_city_avg, AVG(cnt * 1.0 / total) AS avg_share_of_total FROM s WHERE cnt > city_avg GROUP BY City
